newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq forms new listings investigations unit.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq forms new listings investigations unit.

text.p: The Nasdaq Stock Market said on Tuesday it formed a new listings investigations department and named Gary Sundick vice president in charge of it.

The six-member department will scrutinize financial filings, auditors' reports, business plans and other filings from Nasdaq-listed companies to ensure they are reporting accurate, pertinent information, Nasdaq said in a news release.

Sundick, 54, currently is associate director of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission enforcement division. At Nasdaq he will report to John Wall, executive vice president for issuers, investors and international issues.
The Nasdaq Stock Market's parent company is the National Association of Securities Dealers Inc.
